description: Candidate pool: submitted, not yet verified. Entry and promotion rules: docs/candidate-pool.md.

candidates.name: AirGateway Platform API
candidates.summary: Air distribution API with sandbox keys, production certification and an agency application.

candidates.name: Aiven
candidates.summary: Managed databases including free hosted PostgreSQL. Account signup and provisioning remain untested; free lifecycle limits need checking before production use.

candidates.name: Amadeus Flight APIs
candidates.summary: Historical Self-Service flight API and the current Enterprise portal; individual onboarding must be re-established.

candidates.name: apiheya Air Scraper
candidates.summary: An apiheya flight-data product distributed through RapidAPI; distinct from the official Skyscanner partner API.

candidates.name: Aviasales via Travelpayouts
candidates.summary: Travelpayouts-distributed live flight search and a separately accessible historical price-data API.

candidates.name: Baserow Cloud
candidates.summary: Hosted collaborative tables; free workspace and scoped row-access tokens. Schema management uses a different credential.

candidates.name: Bright Data SERP API
candidates.summary: SERP API with a documented Google Flights request; structured fare extraction and onboarding need verification.

candidates.name: Coda / Superhuman Docs
candidates.summary: Docs and tables with a free REST API; current API page is branded Superhuman Docs.

candidates.name: 携程机票合作
candidates.summary: 携程的分销与供应商合作线索；尚未确认面向普通个人的旅客机票搜索 API。

candidates.name: Duffel Flights API
candidates.summary: Flight API whose self-serve test environment must be distinguished from live account activation.

candidates.name: Expedia XAP Flight Listings
candidates.summary: Travel Redirect/XAP flight listings product whose new API applications are currently paused.

candidates.name: 飞书 Feishu
candidates.summary: China-region Feishu workspace and Base APIs; separate account/tenant from international Lark.

candidates.name: 飞猪国内机票开放平台
candidates.summary: 面向机票商家的政策与订单接口，需要企业、代理商身份、店铺和聚石塔；不等同于旅客搜索接口。

candidates.name: Flight MCP
candidates.summary: Authenticated flight lookup and a separate, restricted public cache exposed through REST and MCP.

candidates.name: FlightAPI.io Flight Price API
candidates.summary: Flight-price search for one-way, round-trip and multi-city itineraries, with credit-based usage.

candidates.name: Google Sheets
candidates.summary: Online spreadsheets with a no-additional-cost API; Cloud project and OAuth setup are still prerequisites.

candidates.name: Grist
candidates.summary: Hosted relational spreadsheets with a free personal site, REST API and official MCP.

candidates.name: Ignav Flights
candidates.summary: Flight search and purchase-link API with email signup and an official MCP; individual eligibility remains untested.

candidates.name: KAYAK Affiliate API
candidates.summary: Affiliate flight APIs with a business application and an optional requested sandbox.

candidates.name: Kiwi.com
candidates.summary: Flight search through a publicized MCP path and the separately gated Tequila partnership API.

candidates.name: LetsFG Personal Flight Search
candidates.summary: Personal flight search through MCP, CLI and SDKs, with a human payment-method authorization step.

candidates.name: Lufthansa Partner Fare API
candidates.summary: Lufthansa fare methods are partner-scoped; the developer portal currently pauses new Open API registrations.

candidates.name: paas.build
candidates.summary: Agent-native payment facilitator (the AI-builder product of UniPaaS, FCA-authorised No. 929994) — opens a real merchant account via progressive KYB and creates checkouts through MCP or REST.

candidates.name: PlanetScale
candidates.summary: PostgreSQL single-node plans start at USD 5/month. No free writable database allowance verified; not provisioned in this no-payment round. Public pricing SQL is read-only and does not meet the task.

candidates.name: 去哪儿机票合作
candidates.summary: 去哪儿官方机票及分销合作渠道线索；个人自助机票搜索 API 或 MCP 尚未确认。

candidates.name: Sabre Air APIs
candidates.summary: Air API workflows with assigned credentials, plus a separately researched Agentic API/MCP lead.

candidates.name: Scrapingdog Google Flights API
candidates.summary: Google Flights extraction endpoint charged in platform credits rather than one credit per flight search.

candidates.name: SearchApi Google Flights
candidates.summary: Google Flights extraction API and a hosted MCP integration supporting token or browser authorization.

candidates.name: Serper
candidates.summary: Google results API with signup trial queries; actual account flow and authentication remain untested.

candidates.name: Skootle Google Flights Scraper
candidates.summary: A Skootle-published flight-scraping Actor hosted on Apify, billed by startup and output records.

candidates.name: Skyscanner Travel APIs
candidates.summary: Partner flight APIs and an official MCP, with independently documented business-access paths.

candidates.name: 同程机票合作
candidates.summary: 同程官方机票与出行平台合作线索；普通个人自助搜索 API 的准入、费用和能力尚未确认。

candidates.name: Travelport TripServices
candidates.summary: Travel distribution API requiring trial requests and provider-provisioned production credentials.

candidates.name: Trip.com Flight Distribution
candidates.summary: Trip.com supplier fare-maintenance API lead; a consumer flight-search access path is not yet established.

candidates.name: Turso
candidates.summary: Free cloud account: 100 databases, 5 GB, 500 million reads/month and 10 million writes/month. Signup/login required; local engine alone does not satisfy remote storage.

candidates.name: Xquik
candidates.summary: Hosted X data and account automation service with a REST API, official MCP server, OpenAPI, SDKs, HMAC webhooks, and OAuth 2.1.
